jobs.tierReason: review of changes to the security gate, secret and sensitive routing (new context attached to worker prompts, shell-capable worker lanes with setup commands and test environment), spend (retries) and approval handling
jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/dogfood.diff with the new modules tools/ticket-context.mjs, tools/verify-config.mjs, tools/gitignore-defaults.mjs, tools/contracts-verify.mjs and the design in docs/plans/dogfood-fixes-design.md. Rules that must hold: (1) secrets and sensitive data: the automatic context for tickets (scope Context entries, profile context, backticked paths in requirement text, package.json, design files) can never attach a secret or protected file (dot-env files, keys, anything in the profile protectedPaths, symlinks, files outside the project, huge files) to a worker prompt, and a path given by a worker-written ticket or by scope text cannot make the runner read outside the project; (2) the verify block: setup commands and testEnv come only from the owner's profile (a worker or a batch cannot change them: check the profile-change guard), testEnv cannot carry secrets, a verify job stays sensitive and only goes to lanes that may see sensitive code, and the {tests} expansion cannot turn a test path into a flag or inject arguments; (3) done evidence: scope sync --integrated can never mark a ticket done on a worker's own claim, a skipped or missing tests check, a failed parent batch, a job that the queue rolled back, or a job from a different run, and the retry path cannot loop forever or lose history; (4) the security gate changes: accepted advisories cannot be forged by a worker (they live in the profile, which batches cannot change), expiry and id matching are exact, the temp lockfile build runs no scripts, uses no repository credentials or npmrc, cleans up, and cannot be abused to read files or exfiltrate package.json contents beyond the registry call npm already makes; a malformed advisory list fails closed; (5) the ticket approval hash includes the new fields (tests, skeleton) and a worker-written ticket can never claim origin ci to avoid approval; the runner reseal for ci tickets is the only place that keeps approval; (6) the mock server change and contract self-check: the mock cannot be made to execute code from a hostile contract, the verify step runs the generated tests with a minimal environment and kills the process group on timeout; (7) gitignore edits: no symlink following, never removing lines, idempotent; (8) the api-adapters normalization of empty-find edits and files-plus-edits cannot let a worker write an undeclared output or bypass the output count check. Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
